description: A common benign pigmentary condition causing multiple small pale macules, especially on sun-exposed limbs.
causes: Likely related to chronic sun exposure and age-related changes

appearance.general: Multiple small, sharply demarcated pale or white macules, commonly on the shins and forearms.

doctor_discussion_points: Discuss whether the spots are stable and whether any lesions have changed in character.
